{{Short description|Italian physicist (1927–2023)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=August 2024}}
'''Cesare Marchetti''' (1927 – 16 April 2023) was an Italian physicist.<ref>{{Cite web |title=In Memory of Cesare Marchetti 1927-2023 |url=https://connect.iiasa.ac.at/news/1519240 |access-date=9 August 2024 |website=IIASA Connect |language=en}}</ref> He is best known as the inventor of [[Marchetti's constant]], the idea that people are willing to commute half-an-hour each way. <ref>{{Cite news |date=29 August 2019 |title=The History of Cities Is About How We Get to Work |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2019-08-29/the-commuting-principle-that-shaped-urban-history |access-date=9 August 2024 |work=Bloomberg.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Passing of Cesare Marchetti – The Rockefeller University – Program for the Human Environment |url=https://phe.rockefeller.edu/news/2023/04/16/passing-of-cesare-marchetti/ |access-date=9 August 2024 |website=phe.rockefeller.edu |language=en-US}}</ref> He also conceived of using [[carbon capture and storage]] to reduce [[greenhouse gas emissions]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ma |first1=Jinfeng |last2=Li |first2=Lin |last3=Wang |first3=Haofan |last4=Du |first4=Yi |last5=Ma |first5=Junjie |last6=Zhang |first6=Xiaoli |last7=Wang |first7=Zhenliang |date=July 2022 |title=Carbon Capture and Storage: History and the Road Ahead |journal=Engineering |volume=14 |pages=33–43 |bibcode=2022Engin..14...33M |doi=10.1016/j.eng.2021.11.024 |s2cid=247416947|doi-access=free }}</ref>
